entities.name: 2-Dimethylaminoethyl chloride
observations: Decoded input structure is CN(C)CCCl; listed with HCl, consistent with the hydrochloride salt representation.

entities.name: 2-Hydroxyphenyl trifluoromethyl ketone
observations: Decoded input structure is O=C(c1ccccc1O)C(F)(F)F, an ortho-hydroxy aryl trifluoromethyl ketone.

entities.name: O-Alkylated trifluoromethyl ketone
observations: Directly matching reaction evidence reports 72% yield and retains the aryl C(O)CF3 group.

entities.name: Phenolic O-alkylation assignment
observations: The phenolic oxygen attacks 2-dimethylaminoethyl chloride, replacing chloride and forming Ar-O-CH2CH2-N(CH3)2; diethyl ether, toluene, water, and HCl are treated as solvent, workup, or salt components.
A database alternative lacking the ketone carbonyl was also reported, but it is not the primary assignment.
